name: Goi cuon tom
summary: Gỏi cuốn tôm is a roll of boiled shrimp, greens, and rice noodles in rice paper. Vietnam Airlines says the dip is mắm nêm or peanut sauce, and prints 30,000–50,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines names Cô Giang and Xô Viết Nghệ Tĩnh.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the roll cool and not greasy. The dip is mắm nêm or peanut sauce.
howToEat: The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Cô Giang and Xô Viết Nghệ Tĩnh. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
